rows.title: Primary backups to logically air-gapped vaults
rows.summary: Logically air-gapped vaults are now supported as a primary backup target. This enhancement allows customers to leverage the security and recovery benefits of logically air-gapped vaults while maintaining only a single backup copy, reducing storage and operational costs. Previously, logically air-gapped vaults could only store copies of existing backups. For more information, see Primary backups to logically air-gapped vaults.
